runner.title: Title of the dialog that runs a folder or collection of requests.
runner.scope: Heading above the choice of which requests run.
runner.stop: Button that stops a run that is in progress.
runner.iterations: How many times the whole set runs.
runner.parallel: How many requests are sent at the same time.
runner.rows: Number of rows in a data file.
runner.dataOverrides: {{columns}} is a list of column names from the data file.
runner.dataOverridesMore: {{columns}} lists the first column names; {{count}} is how many more columns exist.
runner.includeTags: Label of a filter that keeps only requests with the chosen tags.
runner.excludeTags: Label of a filter that leaves out requests with the chosen tags.
runner.anyTag: Option meaning no tag filter is applied. Short.
runner.noTag: Option meaning requests without any tag.
runner.skipped: Status of a request that did not run.
runner.outcomes.handled: A request failed, but a flow step caught the failure and continued.
runner.attempt: Retry counter such as 2/3: attempt number, then total attempts.
runner.tests: Passed checks over total checks, for example 3/3 checks.
runner.idle: Explains how a run works before it starts.
runner.inScope: First sentence of the summary under the scope picker.
runner.inScopeSome: {{selected}} is how many requests are chosen, {{count}} is how many exist.
runner.iterationsInScope: Second sentence of the summary, shown when a run repeats.
runner.selection: Heading of the list in which individual requests are ticked.
runner.selected: Summary such as 2 of 5 requests (chosen of total).
runner.includeRequest: Accessible label of a checkbox. {{name}} is a request name.
runner.progressRunning: Progress line while a run is active. Parts are joined with a middle dot.
runner.progressRan: Progress line after a run has finished.
runner.progressRunningMore: Shown when scripts triggered more requests than planned.
runner.progressPassed: Count of requests that passed, for example 4 passed.
runner.progressSkipped: Count of requests that were skipped.
runner.socketSkipped: Reason shown for a WebSocket request that the runner skips.
runner.outcomes.passed: Result of a request in a run: all checks passed. Adjective.
runner.outcomes.failed: Result of a request in a run: a check or the request failed. Adjective.
runner.outcomes.skipped: Result of a request in a run: it was not sent. Adjective.
runner.running: Status label while a run is in progress. Adjective, not a command.
